paragraphs.source_en: Hirate Masahide silently listened to the people whispering among themselves. He still could not fathom Nobunaga’s intentions. Why had he suddenly appeared, only to stride off again so quickly? Such reckless and eccentric conduct ought not to have been Nobunaga’s way; he was plainly issuing an open challenge to everyone. But did he possess the power to subdue his enemies? If not, his behavior was nothing more than foolhardy bravado, unworthy of a great commander.

units.source_en: Hirate Masahide silently listened to the people whispering among themselves.
units.source_zh: 平手政秀默默听着人们的窃窃私语。

units.source_en: He still could not fathom Nobunaga’s intentions. Why had he suddenly appeared, only to stride off again so quickly?

ja.t: がつかめなかった。なぜ

units.source_zh: 他还未能摸透信长的心思，他为何突然出现，又很快扬长而去呢？

units.source_en: Such reckless and eccentric conduct ought not to have been Nobunaga’s way; he was plainly issuing an open challenge to everyone.
units.source_zh: 那种鲁莽的古怪举止不应该是信长所为，他分明在向所有人公开挑战。

units.source_en: But did he possess the power to subdue his enemies?
units.source_zh: 但他有压制住敌人的能力吗？

units.source_en: If not, his behavior was nothing more than foolhardy bravado, unworthy of a great commander.

ja.t: のなすべきことではなかった。

units.source_zh: 如果没有，他的行为无异于匹夫之勇，非大将所为。

paragraphs.source_zh: 平手政秀默默听着人们的窃窃私语。他还未能摸透信长的心思，他为何突然出现，又很快扬长而去呢？那种鲁莽的古怪举止不应该是信长所为，他分明在向所有人公开挑战。但他有压制住敌人的能力吗？如果没有，他的行为无异于匹夫之勇，非大将所为。

paragraphs.source_en: The relatives finished offering incense. Hearing his name called, Masahide came to himself and left his seat.

units.source_en: Hearing his name called, Masahide came to himself and left his seat.
units.source_zh: 听到自己的名字，政秀醒过神来，离开坐席。

paragraphs.source_zh: 亲人们上香完毕。听到自己的名字，政秀醒过神来，离开坐席。

paragraphs.source_en: “My late lord, I have failed you.” Feeling that he had failed the trust Nobuhide had placed in him, he could not keep tears from welling in his eyes as he offered incense. After returning to his seat, Masahide closed his eyes. The image of Nobunaga, a straw rope tied around his waist, flinging incense ash at his father’s spirit tablet kept rising before his eyes and would not leave him.

units.source_en: “My late lord, I have failed you.”
Feeling that he had failed the trust Nobuhide had placed in him, he could not keep tears from welling in his eyes as he offered incense.
units.source_zh: 他自觉有负信秀之托，上香时不禁双眼噙泪。

units.source_en: After returning to his seat, Masahide closed his eyes.
units.source_zh: 回到自己的座位上后，政秀闭上了双眼。

units.source_en: The image of Nobunaga, a straw rope tied around his waist, flinging incense ash at his father’s spirit tablet kept rising before his eyes and would not leave him.
units.source_zh: 他眼前总是浮现出腰系草绳的信长向父亲的灵位扔香灰时的情形，挥之不去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “先主，在下无能。”他自觉有负信秀之托，上香时不禁双眼噙泪。回到自己的座位上后，政秀闭上了双眼。他眼前总是浮现出腰系草绳的信长向父亲的灵位扔香灰时的情形，挥之不去。
